purpose: Validate square matrix structure and sourced closed-interval entry constraints without evaluating systemic-coherence categories or endpoints.

required.statement: Require a positive declared order and a matrix whose row and column counts both equal that order.
Require every matrix entry to belong to the sourced closed interval [-1, 1], including both endpoints.
Return a deterministic structural validation result with active-source traceability and unresolved items preserved.

forbidden.statement: Do not infer endpoint identities, index-set semantics, or compatibility, tension, and opposition categories.
Do not evaluate systemic coherence, invent an output category, infer equivalence, or use historical candidate IRs as active authority.

deferred.statement: UNRES-M, UNRES-ENDPOINTS, UNRES-CATEGORIES, and UNRES-OUTPUT remain unresolved and require external scientific authority.

operations.purpose: Validate declared square order and every entry against the exact sourced closed interval.

inputs.name: matrix
inputs.semantic_role: ordered matrix rows containing opaque scalar entries

constraints.statement: The number of rows and the number of entries in every row must equal declared_order.
Every entry must satisfy membership in the exact sourced closed interval [-1, 1].
The declared order is a positive integer.

fields.name: accepted
fields.semantic_role: true only when both shape and interval constraints pass

fields.name: unresolved_items
fields.semantic_role: preserved endpoint category order and output reservations

preconditions.statement: The matrix, positive declared order, source identity, relation identity, and provenance are present.

postconditions.statement: Success is returned only when square shape and all closed-interval constraints pass.
No category, endpoint identity, or scientific evaluation result is added.
Active sources, unresolved items, the provisional assumption, and historical comparison status remain traceable.

invariants.statement: The interval is closed and includes -1 and 1.
Matrix entry order and opaque scalar identities remain unchanged.
Historical candidate IRs never override the active contract and registry IR.

steps: validate matrix presence and declared order

partial_order.before: validate matrix presence and declared order
validate matrix presence and declared order

error_contract.condition: Source error identifier declared_order_mismatch: the matrix dimensions do not both match declared_order.
Source error identifier non_square_matrix: row lengths are inconsistent or rows and columns differ.
Source error identifier entry_outside_closed_interval: at least one entry is outside the exact sourced interval [-1, 1].

time_complexity.value: At least every matrix entry must be inspected unless an earlier structural error is returned.

implementation_modes.statement: Implement square-shape and exact closed-interval checks.
Do not infer endpoint identity, category mapping, equivalence, or scientific evaluation.
Traversal and internal check ordering are free subject to both validations preceding success.

global_invariants.statement: The active mathematical contract and active registry IR govern; historical candidates are traceable comparison material only.

dependencies.purpose: Endpoint category order and output reservations.
